canal.line: They walked alone by the old canal
stanza: They walked alone by the old canal
A little confused, I remember well
And stopped into a strange hotel
With a neon burning bright
He felt the heat of the night
Hit him like a freight train
Moving with a simple twist of fate

chaparral.line: On a bed made of chaparral
stanza: And above all this folderol
On a bed made of chaparral
She is laid, a coronal placed on her brow
And the babe, all in slumber dreams
Of a place filled with quiet streams
And the lake where her cradle was pulled from the water
And we'll all come praise the infanta
And we'll all come praise the infanta

gal.songTitle: Don’t Think Twice, It’s All Right
gal.line: So it ain't no use in calling out my name, gal
stanza: So it ain't no use in calling out my name, gal
Like you never done before
And it ain't no use in calling out my name, gal
I can't hear you anymore
I'm a-thinking and a-wondering, walking down the road
I once loved a woman, a child, I'm told
I give her my heart but she wanted my soul
But don't think twice, it's all right

gal.line: Well I'm in love, I'm in love with a beautiful gal
stanza: Well I'm in love, I'm in love with a beautiful gal
That's what's the matter with me
Well I'm in love, I'm in love with a beautiful gal
But she don't care about me
Lord, I tried and I tried to keep her satisfied
But she just wouldn't stay
So now that she is leaving this is all I can say
She's hot to go she's ready
She's hot to go right now
She's hot to go
You've got to know
That stop-and-do-it gal

mal.songTitle: She Came In Through the Bathroom Window
stanza: Oh, listen to that Mal
Heh, heh, heh, heh
Oh, look out! He's c—
No, squeeze, pal...
